## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD5: tests/scripts/test-llm-api-call.sh covers both providers with mocked curl, verifies envelope normalization, and asserts that a misconfigured-model 4xx surfaces a single stderr line containing the provider name, tier name, offending model ID, and the provider's error text, with a non-zero exit code

## Description
Write tests/scripts/test-llm-api-call.sh — a new test file exercising plugins/dso/scripts/llm-api-call.sh (not yet written — tests will be RED until the implementation task completes).

Tests use the mock-curl-on-PATH pattern from test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh: write a mock curl binary in a temp dir, prepend to PATH, invoke the script under test.

Tests to write (Given/When/Then format):

1. test_anthropic_constructs_correct_headers
   Given model.provider=anthropic, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=test-key, valid system-prompt-file and user-message
   When llm-api-call.sh is invoked with tier=standard
   Then captured curl args contain -H "x-api-key: test-key" and -H "anthropic-version: 2023-06-01"

2. test_openai_constructs_correct_headers
   Given model.provider=openai, OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-test, valid system-prompt-file and user-message
   When llm-api-call.sh is invoked with tier=light
   Then captured curl args contain -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-test" and NO x-api-key header

3. test_anthropic_normalizes_response_envelope
   Given model.provider=anthropic, mock curl returns {"content":[{"text":"{\"foo\":1}"}],"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
   When llm-api-call.sh is invoked
   Then stdout contains {"foo":1} (inner text extracted from content[].text envelope)

4. test_openai_normalizes_response_envelope
   Given model.provider=openai, mock curl returns {"choices":[{"message":{"content":"{\"foo\":2}"}}]}
   When llm-api-call.sh is invoked
   Then stdout contains {"foo":2} (inner content extracted from choices[].message.content envelope)

5. test_missing_api_key_exits_nonzero
   Given model.provider=anthropic, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY unset
   When llm-api-call.sh is invoked
   Then exit code is non-zero and stderr contains "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"

6. test_wrong_provider_key_exits_nonzero
   Given model.provider=anthropic, only OPENAI_API_KEY set (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY unset)
   When llm-api-call.sh is invoked
   Then exit code is non-zero (wrong-provider key does not substitute)

7. test_4xx_error_surfaces_diagnostic
   Given model.provider=anthropic, mock curl writes HTTP 400 error JSON {"error":{"type":"invalid_request_error","message":"model not found"}} to stdout with exit 22 (curl HTTP error)
   When llm-api-call.sh is invoked with tier=standard and model.standard=invalid-model
   Then exit code is non-zero and stderr contains a single line with: "anthropic", "standard", "invalid-model", and "model not found"

8. test_openai_request_body_contains_response_format
   Given model.provider=openai, OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-test, captured curl body
   When llm-api-call.sh is invoked
   Then captured request body JSON contains response_format.type == "json_object"

## Files to Modify
- tests/scripts/test-llm-api-call.sh (CREATE)
- .test-index (ADD RED marker)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] tests/scripts/test-llm-api-call.sh exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-llm-api-call.sh
- [ ] .test-index contains RED marker [test_anthropic_constructs_correct_headers] for plugins/dso/scripts/llm-api-call.sh
  Verify: grep 'test_anthropic_constructs_correct_headers' "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index"
- [ ] Test file contains at least 8 test functions
  Verify: grep -c "^test_" tests/scripts/test-llm-api-call.sh | awk '{exit ($1 < 8)}'
- [ ] Tests run and all FAIL (RED) — llm-api-call.sh does not yet exist
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-llm-api-call.sh 2>&1 | grep -q "FAIL\|not found\|No such"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

AC amendment: add test_markdown_fence_stripping test (DD4 gap)
Test 9 — test_markdown_fence_stripping:
  Given model.provider=anthropic (or openai), mock curl returns a response where the content/message contains a JSON value wrapped in markdown fences (```json\n{...}\n```)
  When llm-api-call.sh is invoked
  Then stdout contains the unwrapped JSON object (fences stripped), not the raw fenced string
This covers DD4: 'tests assert that prose-wrapped JSON (e.g., markdown fences) is normalized or rejected consistently across providers'
